scope: linear 2-6 ActionRun dependency, aggregate, stop and replay lineage
separate explicit promotion boundary with review-candidate merge only; no Repair apply, confirm, version or export

implementation.dependency_rule: first action has no dependency; each later action depends exactly on the previous run_id

verification.runtime_focused: cargo test -p forgecad-runtime --lib agentic_action_run_revalidates_bound_candidate_and_is_idempotent --offline: PASS (negative composition stops at first quality gate, source candidate unchanged, exact replay)
verification.positive_composition_conformance: cargo test -p forgecad-runtime --lib agentic_repair_apply_prepare_accepts_strict_improvement_and_is_idempotent --offline: PASS (two reviewable actions, cumulative parent hash chain, distinct merged review candidate, exact replay)
verification.negative_boundary: PASS: one-item, non-linear dependency and untyped action inputs fail closed

positive_fixture.fixture_scope: deterministic Runtime self-rendered target; not real-reference likeness evidence

not_proven: active source candidate mutation or Repair application of the merged candidate
user-approved promotion, immutable version creation or export
real Codex multi-action visual conformance, human visual review, PBR likeness and 360-degree gates
